content.text: {"id": "mm5121a2", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "CDC analyzed BRFSS data from 1991, 1993, 1995, 1997, and 1999 for persons from the 50 states and the District of Columbia"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "increased significantly from 22.9% in 1991 to 24.9% in 1999"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "remained relatively constant at 95.3% in 1991 and 94.5% in 1999"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "increased significantly from 22.9% in 1991 to 24.9% in 1999"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "In 1999, age-adjusted prevalence of self-reported HBP ranged from 14.0% in Arizona to 31.6% in Alabama"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Recent BP screening declined significantly among persons aged 20--44 years and those aged 45--64 years"}]}, {"v": "stratified/adjusted", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "In 1991 and 1999, age-adjusted prevalences of recent BP screening were higher among non-Hispanic blacks"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Prevalences were age-adjusted to the 2000 U.S. standard population."}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "cross-sectional", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "BRFSS is a state-based, random-digit--dialed telephone survey of the civilian, noninstitutionalized U.S. population"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "This report summarizes data from the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS) on state-specific trends"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Data were weighted and analyzed using SUDAAN (version 7.0) to account for the complex sampling design in each state"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Prevalences were age-adjusted to the 2000 U.S. standard population."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "The state-specific percentage point differences between 1991 and 1999 for recent BP screening and HBP were limited to DC and the 47 states"}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["study_design"]}
